personality_one_liner: A vibrant, touchable, and transparent marketplace where Gen Z can find housing through playful discovery and community-driven negotiations.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use large tap targets. Avoid dense grid groupings. Let the screen breathe.

do's: Apply frosted glass to the bottom tab bar.
Apply glass to sticky action buttons, map floating filters, and bottom-sheet headers.
Apply glass to hero property cards over map.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body text containers or standard list rows.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: A map-first discovery feed where users browse available properties via floating glass cards.

states.empty: Playful illustration of an empty neighborhood + 'No homes found in this area' + 'Zoom out' CTA.

screens.layout: Map view fills the background (react-native-maps). Glassmorphic floating search/filter pill at the top safe area. A bottom sheet or horizontal carousel of floating glass cards at the bottom. Tapping a card brings it to focus on the map. Toggle between map and list view via a floating action button.

screens.name: ListingDetail
screens.purpose: Showcase a property with immersive photos, dynamic pricing (Weeks/Months/Years), tenant offers, and contact options.
screens.layout: Full-bleed photo carousel at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (Layer 1) and back/heart icons. Details section below with large, emphasized Pricing + Period Badge. Includes a mini-map for location. Tenant offers stacked in soft playful cards below the description. A sticky, glassmorphic bottom bar for 'Make an Offer' / 'Contact via WhatsApp/Phone'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Display user bios, contact info, and reviews in a tactile, Gen Z-friendly manner.
screens.layout: Avatar (cool GenZ portrait) centered over a subtle tinted gradient or pattern background. Bio text, Phone, and WhatsApp pill buttons. Threaded reviews displayed in nested rounded bubbles.

screens.name: CreateListing
screens.purpose: Allow homeowners to easily upload photos, auto-detect currency, set price periods, and post listings.
screens.layout: Step-by-step or single-column form with large, touchable inputs. Address autocomplete field. Segmented control for Rent Period (Week/Month/Year). Auto-detected local currency display with an override option. Sticky submit button in KeyboardAvoidingView.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile/Playful (Personality 4) guidelines. The app should feel touchable with large tap targets, pill controls, and subtle overshoot springs.
Implement glassmorphism heavily on sticky/floating elements: use expo-glass-effect (iOS) or expo-blur (Android) for the bottom tab bar, map filter pills, and bottom action bars.
Ensure the Rent Period (Week/Month/Year) is visually emphasized next to the listing price, using the brandPrimary color or a prominent badge.
Map View is the primary discovery interface. Listings on the map should use React Native Maps. Overlay floating glass property cards that update as the map pans.
Tenant Offers and Reviews must feature nested replies. Use rounded bubbles and clear visual hierarchy to separate comments from threaded replies.
Do NOT use any shades of Blue, Purple, Indigo, Violet, Orange, or Terracotta. We are using a vibrant Emerald and Sunny Yellow Gen-Z palette.
Include a Gradient Scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) on any full-bleed image (e.g. Listing detail hero) before overlaying text.
Provide WhatsApp and Phone deep-linking buttons on user profiles and listing pages.
Ensure forms (Create Listing) have sticky CTAs at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView, avoiding float labels.
